26:40.text: [who were on Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) religion of disbelief]

26:41.text: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Fir‘aun
: "Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?"

26:42.text: He said: "Yes, and you shall then verily be of those brought near

26:43.text: said to them: "Throw what you are going to throw!"

26:44.text: So they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said: "By the might of Fir‘aun
, it is we who will certainly win!"

26:45.text: threw his stick, and behold, it swallowed up all that they falsely showed!

26:46.text: And the sorcerers fell down prostrate.

26:47.text: Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

26:49.text: said: "You have believed in him before I give you leave. Surely, he indeed is your chief, who has taught you magic! So verily, you shall come to know. Verily, I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all."

26:50.text: They said: "No harm! Surely, to our Lord

26:51.text: "Verily we really hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we are the first of the believers
[in Mûsâ (Moses) and in the Monotheism which he has brought from Allâh]

26:52.text: , saying: "Depart by night with My slaves, verily you will be pursued."

26:54.text: : "Verily these indeed are but a small band.

26:55.text: "And verily, they have done what has enraged us.

26:56.text: "But we are a host all assembled, amply fore-warned."

26:57.text: So, We expelled them from gardens and springs,

26:58.text: Treasures, and every kind of honourable place.

26:59.text: and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.

26:60.text: So they pursued them at sunrise.
